nodes.label: services/api (Hono on Vercel)
nodes.rationale: Bundled with esbuild (D13) because Vercel's Node builder cannot handle raw-TS workspace packages; keeps the production domain (D7) so all inbound integrations keep working.

nodes.label: D10: ops reports cross-owner access (accepted risk)
nodes.rationale: Accepted because the operator is the only learner; fix is an OPS_OWNER_IDS allowlist via withOperator middleware before a second learner exists. Uses ALL_OWNERS unique symbol.

nodes.label: D13: services/api esbuild bundle
nodes.rationale: Spike found Vercel does not handle raw-TS workspace package exports; rejected alternative was compiling shared to dist/.
